say:1:1322465001:0.text: Thanks to you, Whiteridge is back on its feet.
say:1:1322465001:0.source_cn: 多亏了你，白山重回了正轨。
say:1:1322465001:0.male: Thanks to you, Whiteridge is back on its feet.
say:1:1322465001:0.female: Thanks to you, Whiteridge is back on its feet.

say:2:1322465002:0.text: And my work is finally starting to show results. The villagers are being freed from their delusions, and their faith is being restored.
say:2:1322465002:0.source_cn: 我的工作也有了成效，镇民们正逐渐从执念中走出来，信仰问...

say:3:1322465003:2.text: That's good to hear! Now the cult won't have any ground to stand on!
say:3:1322465003:2.source_cn: 太好了，这样邪教就没有了萌发的土壤！

say:5:1322465005:1.text: I've sent word to the Lightbearer Temple, asking for their help with the investigation. It won't be easy to dig into a court mage, but we'll find a way.
say:5:1322465005:1.source_cn: 我已经传信给耀光圣堂，请他们协助调查。虽然想要调查一位...

say:6:1322465006:1.text: Oh, and there's one more thing.

say:7:1322465007:1.text: It seems the cultists mostly targeted villagers who were struggling in life. The temple will be paying extra attention to those people moving forward.
say:7:1322465007:1.source_cn: 我发现受到蛊惑的邪教徒多是生活中不顺意的镇民，圣堂接下...

say:8:1322465008:1.text: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?
say:8:1322465008:1.source_cn: 也许……你愿意和我一起去探望这些镇民？
say:8:1322465008:1.male: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?
say:8:1322465008:1.female: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?

choice_prompt:9:1322465008.female: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?

say:10:1322465009:1.text: You're every bit as kind as I remember.
say:10:1322465009:1.source_cn: 和我记忆中的一样，你总是如此慷慨。
say:10:1322465009:1.male: You're every bit as kind as I remember.
say:10:1322465009:1.female: You're every bit as kind as I remember.
